From 364aece01a2dd748fc36a1e8bf52ef639b0857bd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Peter Antoine <peter.antoine@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2015 08:50:45 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: Avoid GPU hang when coming out of s3 or s4

This patch fixes a timing issue that causes a GPU hang when the system
comes out of power saving.

During pm_resume, We are submitting batchbuffers before enabling
Interrupts this is causing us to miss the context switch interrupt,
and in consequence intel_execlists_handle_ctx_events is not triggered.

This patch is based on a patch from Deepak S <deepak.s@intel.com>
from another platform.

The patch fixes an issue introduced by:
  commit e7778be1eab918274f79603d7c17b3ec8be77386
  drm/i915: Fix startup failure in LRC mode after recent init changes

The above patch added a call to init_context() to fix an issue introduced
by a previous patch. But, it then opened up a small timing window for the
batches being added by the init_context (basically setting up the context)
to complete before the interrupts have been turned on, thus hanging the
GPU.

Bugzilla: https://bugs.freedesktop.org/show_bug.cgi?id=89600
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # 4.0+
Signed-off-by: Peter Antoine <peter.antoine@intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Daniel Vetter <daniel.vetter@ffwll.ch>
[Jani: fixed typo in subject, massaged the comments a bit]
Signed-off-by: Jani Nikula <jani.nikula@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_drv.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_drv.c
index c302ffb5a168..a19d2c71e205 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_drv.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_drv.c
@@ -699,6 +699,16 @@ static int i915_drm_resume(struct drm_device *dev)
 	intel_init_pch_refclk(dev);
 	drm_mode_config_reset(dev);
 
+	/*
+	 * Interrupts have to be enabled before any batches are run. If not the
+	 * GPU will hang. i915_gem_init_hw() will initiate batches to
+	 * update/restore the context.
+	 *
+	 * Modeset enabling in intel_modeset_init_hw() also needs working
+	 * interrupts.
+	 */
+	intel_runtime_pm_enable_interrupts(dev_priv);
+
 	mutex_lock(&dev->struct_mutex);
 	if (i915_gem_init_hw(dev)) {
 		DRM_ERROR("failed to re-initialize GPU, declaring wedged!\n");
@@ -706,9 +716,6 @@ static int i915_drm_resume(struct drm_device *dev)
 	}
 	mutex_unlock(&dev->struct_mutex);
 
-	/* We need working interrupts for modeset enabling ... */
-	intel_runtime_pm_enable_interrupts(dev_priv);
-
 	intel_modeset_init_hw(dev);
 
 	spin_lock_irq(&dev_priv->irq_lock);
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_drv.c`**
   - Added a block of comments explaining the necessity of enabling interrupts before running any batches to prevent GPU hangs.
   - Moved the call to `intel_runtime_pm_enable_interrupts(dev_priv);` to a position before any batch submissions occur during the `pm_resume` process. This ensures that interrupts are enabled prior to the execution of batch buffers, which is critical for avoiding GPU hangs.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in the `i915_drv.c` file address a timing issue that was introduced by a previous patch (commit e7778be1eab918274f79603d7c17b3ec8be77386). The earlier patch added a call to `init_context()` that inadvertently created a timing window where batch submissions could occur before interrupts were enabled. This patch corrects that by ensuring interrupts are enabled first, thus preventing the GPU from hanging when the system resumes from power-saving states (S3 or S4). The changes are directly related to fixing the issue caused by the previous commit, thereby improving the overall stability of the GPU during resume operations.


```c
intel_runtime_pm_enable_interrupts(dev_priv);
i915_gem_init_hw(dev);
```

This change prevents the timing issue that leads to missing the context switch interrupt, thereby allowing proper handling of context events and avoiding GPU hangs during system resume.
